title: superglue partners with Pine Services Group
summary: Pine Services Group's firms run ERP implementations for more than 10,000 customers. We've signed a group-wide agreement that opens superglue to all 18 of them, starting with a NetSuite implementation at The Vested Group.
body_markdown:
[Pine Services Group](https://pineservicesgroup.com/) 's firms run ERP implementations for more than 10,000 customers across the US, UK, Ireland and Australia, on Sage, NetSuite, Microsoft, Acumatica, iplicit, QAD, SAP Business One, MYOB Acumatica and Epicor. We've signed a group-wide agreement that opens superglue to all 18 of them, starting with a NetSuite implementation at The Vested Group.


Pine's firms are building AI-first implementation practices, and together we're setting the precedent for what agentic ERP implementations look like in the future.


superglue's agents take over the manual work of an implementation project. It guides the consultant through each step and utilizes the consultant’s greatest strengths - having a deep understanding of how companies work in specialized niches.


That strongly changes where a consultant's hours go. Clients pay for judgment, for someone who knows which configuration is right for their business, and that is what the teams can focus on.


One superglue client, a[Sage VAR](https://superglue.ai/case-studies/sage-var/) running 40 active Sage Intacct implementations, cut migration and configuration hours per project by 80%. This freed up capacity significantly, and allowed them to deliver up to 40% more implementations.


## Every project unlocks new improvements


Pine's firms run projects that look structurally alike: the same source systems, the same target ERPs, the same master data problems. Today each firm solves them alone, and the logic only exists in the head of whoever did it.


Client documentation feeds the superglue brain and Playbooks carry what worked forward, so a pattern proven at one Sage firm is a starting point at the next rather than a blank page. The eighteenth project costs less than the first.


"We're excited to welcome superglue to the Pine Community. Their AI-powered approach to implementation gives our operating companies a revolutionary way to connect applications, automate workflows, and solve complex customer integration challenges out of the box. This partnership supports Pine's strategy of bringing practical AI solutions to our customers that drive efficiency, accelerate innovation, and deliver measurable business value."


Chris Milan, VP of Strategic Partnerships, Pine Services Group


"What stood out early was how quickly superglue’s agent understood the shape of a NetSuite implementation. It handles the data-intensive tasks while our consultants review and approve the work, and what we learn on each project carries forward to the next instead of staying with one individual. That combination is what an AI-first implementation practice looks like in action, and it’s already delivering real value for our teams."


John Mack, Chief Innovation Officer of Pine Services Group and CEO of The Vested Group


Work is already underway with The Vested Group, a NetSuite partner, and with i-Tech, an Acumatica partner. See Pine's entire portfolio of companies:[https://pineservicesgroup.com/grove/](https://pineservicesgroup.com/grove/)
